 As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll bring the frontier of AI research and engineering to Rowspace, transforming how our platform understands and surfaces critical financial insights.  What You'll Do
   

  

* Implement and adapt cutting\-edge AI research to build systems that understand financial context and business concepts

* Create evaluation frameworks to measure and improve AI performance across investment research, due diligence, and portfolio monitoring tasks
* Design and implement systems that maintain traceability from AI outputs to primary sources
* Experiment with the latest LLM orchestration patterns and context management techniques for financial use cases
* Shape technical direction and best practices for AI application development at Rowspace

 What You Have
   

  

* 3\+ years of experience in machine learning, AI research, or applied AI engineering

* Experience designing evaluation frameworks and benchmarks for AI systems
* Interest or understanding of financial markets, investment processes, or quantitative finance (or strong interest in learning)
* Experience with retrieval systems, embeddings, and multi\-modal data processing
* Publication record or demonstrated expertise in relevant AI research areas is a plus
* Entrepreneurial mindset with ability to translate cutting\-edge research into practical business value

 Perks \& Benefits
